brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT
Use case: illustration-story / editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished landscape PNG thumbnail for a Japanese basketball analysis article. Target 1536×864, approximately 16:9, minimum width 1000 px.

Editorial content is exclusively the provided fixed article: Nagoya Diamond Dolphins won their latest five games; TEAM average points conceded 73.4 is the lowest among 26 teams when comparing each team's latest five games. Opponent strength and schedule differences have NOT been adjusted. Do not introduce any other statistics, player accomplishments, dates, or match events.

Visual style: follow the approved black-and-lime ink illustration look already viewed in this conversation. Background charcoal black #151A18, sharp lime #CCF43B and warm ivory typography, expressive hand-drawn black ink, dry-brush texture, sparse energetic brush strokes. High contrast, strong condensed Japanese sans-serif headlines, polished sports editorial cover with very few elements. Clearly drawn illustration, NOT photographic or photorealistic.

Subject: exactly ONE real professional basketball player, Ryan Luther (ライアン・ルーサー). He was randomly selected from the four players named in the fixed article. His OFFICIAL Nagoya player portrait was visually checked at https://nagoya-dolphins.jp/team/players/detail/id=23897?PlayerID=51000396 and the portrait image https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026110820/files/user/roster/729/2026-27/51000396_01.jpg .
Observed likeness to preserve: light complexion; short dark-brown hair with closely trimmed sides, a slightly textured side-swept top; broad forehead, light eyes under straight dark eyebrows; straight prominent nose; long oval-to-angular face, defined jaw; neatly short brown beard/stubble along cheeks, chin and upper lip; tall athletic broad-shouldered build. Render these specific features in confident ink and ivory highlights, face clearly legible. Do NOT substitute a generic invented athlete.
Clothes: plain red basketball jersey with black edging and plain matching shorts, completely without team/league/sponsor logos, insignia, text, player names, numbers, or branded shoes.
Action: a dynamic defensive lateral slide, bent knees, torso leaned forward, one arm extended laterally and the other raised, both natural open hands visible. Three-quarter view with face turned enough toward viewer to read likeness. No other people, no ball, no hoop needed. This is a conceptual play illustration, never a recreation of a specific real game moment.

Composition: athlete on the LEFT approximately 44% of canvas, active silhouette large and balanced, head, fingers and feet entirely within frame. A few lime diagonal brush strokes behind him. All editorial text grouped on the RIGHT 52%, clean alignment and clear spacing. Team headline visibly governs all numerical claims; do not associate the numbers with the individual athlete. Avoid overlap between hands and text. 5% safe margins. Full-width subdued footer zone with readable qualifiers and AI disclosure.

Render only the following exact Japanese text (the player name must NOT appear anywhere):
Top-right heading: "名古屋D"
Below it, prominent but smaller: "直近5試合 全勝"
Small stat heading: "平均失点"
Largest lime stat: "73.4点"
Bold ivory explanatory line: "26チーム最少"
Footer line 1: "各チームの直近5試合で比較"
Footer line 2: "相手の強さ・日程の違いは未調整"
Footer line 3: "イラスト（AI生成）／イメージ"

Make every Japanese glyph correct and fully readable, including "失点" and "未調整". No additional text or watermarks. Do not carry over any player names or stats from the approved style sample. Do not paste the official photo into the artwork. Final result must be an original hand-drawn-style illustration with a recognizable real player and strong editorial typography.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION PROMPT
Edit target = first input, the just-generated black/lime Japanese basketball thumbnail. Supporting identity reference = second input, OFFICIAL Ryan Luther portrait, for facial features ONLY. This is the ONE permitted correction.

Change ONLY the athlete's head/face/hair/facial-hair to better match the real Ryan Luther shown in the official portrait. Keep the same dynamic defensive stance, body and hands, red jersey, entire composition, background, type positions, colors, all correct text, and all margins exactly unchanged. Maintain the bold hand-drawn editorial ink illustration style. Do not paste the photo or make any part photographic.

The target's hair is too long/high and its beard too heavy. Match the official portrait: short dark brown close-trimmed sides, modest short side-swept textured top (much shorter and flatter than target); wider clear forehead; straight brows rather than exaggerated angry brows; light blue-gray eyes with the spacing and lids of the reference; straight defined nose; broad but softly angular jaw; thin natural lips, calm concentration with a slightly open mouth if needed for the action pose. Closely clipped light brown stubble on cheeks, jaw and upper lip, NOT a full thick beard. Reduce exaggerated deep forehead/facial creases. Preserve a recognizable illustrated Ryan Luther; never generic invented player.

Do not import ANY photo jersey graphics, team/league/sponsor logo, lettering, player name or number. Jersey remains solid red with black trim and NO markings. No additional players, objects or text. No claim about the player's performance; all numbers refer to the team.

Preserve the following exact existing text content, fully legible:
名古屋D
直近5試合 全勝
平均失点
73.4点
26チーム最少
各チームの直近5試合で比較
相手の強さ・日程の違いは未調整
イラスト（AI生成）／イメージ

Preserve landscape approximately 16:9 and at least 1000 px wide. Return exactly one finished PNG.
